name: Ningyo no Namida
source:
Hero goes out looking for the bride in a fantasy world. He meets different characters and animals and talks to them to solve their problems.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1984.html]vndbreview[/url]]


This game is a often mentioned in the subject about what was the first doujin software.

Some claim that this game is the first doujin software
Some claim that such software (unofficial software made and sold by individuals or small groups as a hobby) existed even before this work, although it was not called "doujin software".

However, at least it seems certain that this game is the first software called "Doujin Soft".
translation:
英雄在奇幻世界中寻找新娘。他遇到了不同的人物和动物，并与他们交谈以解决他们的问题。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1984.html]vndbreview[/url]]


这个游戏是关于第一个同人软件的主题中经常提到的。

有人声称这款游戏是第一款同人软件
有些人声称此类软件（个人或小团体出于爱好而制作和销售的非官方软件）甚至在本作品之前就已经存在，尽管它不被称为“同人软件”。

不过，至少看起来可以肯定，这款游戏是第一个名为“同人软件”的软件。
